PURPOSE AND OBJECTIVE
The purpose of this policy is to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of all information assets
owned, managed, or processed by Zyro Dynamics Pvt. Ltd. This policy establishes the standards for acceptable
use of company IT systems, data, and network infrastructure, and defines the responsibilities of all users in
protecting these assets.
SCOPE AND APPLICABILITY
This policy applies to all employees, contractors, interns, vendors, and any third party who accesses Zyro
Dynamics systems, networks, or data in any capacity. It covers all company-owned and company-managed IT
assets, including laptops, mobile devices, servers, cloud services, email systems, and network infrastructure,
regardless of the physical location from which they are accessed.
ACCEPTABLE USE OF IT ASSETS
Company Devices
  Company-issued devices, including laptops, mobile phones, and peripherals, are provided primarily for
business use. Incidental personal use during non-business hours is permitted provided it does not interfere
with work performance.

 Installing software on a company device without prior approval from the IT team is strictly prohibited. All
software requests must be raised through the ZyroDesk helpdesk portal.
 Company devices must not be used to access, download, or store inappropriate content, including adult
material, pirated media, or illegal software.
 Any lost or stolen company device must be reported to IT Security immediately at
security@zyrodyn amics.com so that the device can be remotely wiped and access credentials revoked.
Internet and Network Usage
  Corporate internet access may be used for moderate personal browsing during non-working hours.
High-bandwidth streaming, torrenting, and accessing prohibited websites are not permitted at any time on the
corporate network.
 All internet traffic on the Zyro Dynamics network is monitored and logged for security and compliance
purposes. Employees should have no expectation of personal privacy when using company network
resources.
 Accessing company systems over public Wi-Fi is strictly prohibited without an active VPN connection.

REMOTE WORK SECURITY
  VPN must be active at all times when accessing Zyro Dynamics systems from outside the office network.
No exceptions are permitted.
 Home routers must be secured with WPA2 or WPA3 encryption and a strong, unique password.
 Screen lock must activate automatically after a maximum of 5 minutes of inactivity on any company device.
 Confidential documents must not be printed at home, in a co-working space, or in any public environment.
 Zyro Dynamics reserves the right to remotely lock or wipe any company device that is reported stolen, lost,
or believed to be compromised, without prior notice.
BRING YOUR OWN DEVICE (BYOD)
Employees who wish to use a personal device to access Zyro Dynamics systems must register the device with
the IT team and have the company's Mobile Device Management (MDM) profile installed. Personal devices used
for work must comply with all password, encryption, and VPN requirements set out in this policy. The Company
reserves the right to remotely wipe company data from any registered personal device.
INCIDENT REPORTING
Any actual or suspected security incident, including data loss, malware infection, phishing, unauthorised access,
or device loss, must be reported to the IT Security team without delay at security@zyrodyn amics.com. Timely
reporting is critical to minimising damage. Employees who fail to report a known or suspected incident may be
held accountable for the resulting harm.
